howToReport.step1: Tap "Report" at the bottom of the screen.
howToReport.step3: Choose your area (Purok) and type the street or a landmark.

whatToReport.intro: You can report these four kinds of environmental problems:
whatToReport.wasteDisposal: Uncollected garbage, illegal dumping, overflowing bins.
whatToReport.pollution: Smoke from burning trash, bad smells, dirty water in canals.
whatToReport.flooding: Flooded streets, blocked or overflowing canals after rain.
whatToReport.otherHazard: Open manholes, fallen trees, broken or sparking wires.

privacy.title: Data Privacy Notice
privacy.registerIntro: Before you create an account, please read our
privacy.consentLabel: I have read and agree to the Data Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: Barangay Landayan respects your privacy. This notice explains, in plain words, how the Smart Environmental Reporting System uses your personal data, as required by the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173).
collected: Your name, address, and mobile number
Your username and password (the password is stored in a protected form that no one can read)
The reports you send: issue type, area, street or landmark, description, and date
The photos you attach to your reports
Your messages with the help bot and with barangay staff in Help and Support
Your ratings and comments about how your reports were handled
why: To create your account and confirm that you are a resident of Barangay Landayan
To receive your reports and send them to the right response team
To contact you and send you updates about your reports
To answer your questions in Help and Support
To make summaries that help the barangay plan its work (these summaries do not show your name)
who: You can see your own account, reports, photos, and messages.
The response team assigned to your report can see that report, its photos, and your name.
The LGU administrator of Barangay Landayan can see all reports and accounts to manage the system.
Barangay staff who answer Help and Support can see the messages in that chat.
Your name, address, and mobile number are never shown on the public landing page. Resolved cases shown there have no personal data.
privacy.keep: Your account and reports are kept while your account is active, and then for the period the barangay must keep its records.
privacy.toBeConfirmed: to be confirmed by the barangay
rights: You can see and correct your name, address, and mobile number anytime in Profile.
You can ask the barangay to correct, block, or delete your personal data, or ask how it is used.
You can file a complaint with the National Privacy Commission (privacy.gov.ph).
